PROP-api-request-post-001.text: After role sync, response success=true implies roles_assigned and roles_removed are valid arrays.
PROP-api-request-post-001.assertion: forall syncResp: syncResp.success == true => Array.isArray(syncResp.roles_assigned) && Array.isArray(syncResp.roles_removed)

locations.note: Checks result.success but accesses result.synced/failed/total — does not validate roles_assigned or roles_removed arrays
